authorization: User approved starting the 1–2 month VLA improvement project and automatic follow-through within resource limits.
root_rule: Fixed t=60 for all 200 episodes; t=120 additionally if the baseline is still active at that time (69 cases). No future success filtering.

methods.name: continue
methods.rule: Resume original RNG at number of previous calls; execute prefix5 to the same total 220-step cap.

methods.name: fine20
methods.rule: Same RNG at the root; prefix1 for exactly 20 actual actions, then return to prefix5.

methods.name: resample5
methods.rule: Restart the policy noise stream using the frozen independent root seed, retain prefix5 for the remainder.

methods.name: retreat5_fine20
methods.rule: Five legal OSC commands [0,0,0.3,0,0,0,-1] (upwards with open gripper), then 20 prefix1 actions and return to prefix5. All actions count toward 220.

method_order: continue first as the per-root integrity control, then fine20,resample5,retreat5_fine20; each branch starts from an independently replayed identical root.

reset_protocol.history_rule: For case index i, instantiate a fresh environment; replay reset + init state + 10 dummy waits for each anchor j<i, then seed/reset/set target state and wait 10. No policy calls in warmup. This preserves the old five-anchor initial scenes and is independent of subset/queue/variant order.
reset_protocol.scope_note: Common reproducible scene definitions across conditions; not a claim of byte-identical official 50-trial sequential reset semantics.

state_reconstruction: Canonical initialization plus exact replay of all original actions to the root, rebuilding native controller/internal history. No claim that qpos/qvel alone restore state. No rollout rewind after a branch begins.
rng_reconstruction: Policy.infer splits its JAX key once per call. Rebuild original key from episode seed and advance the carried key root_step/5 times; first continue prediction must match the archived chunk.

acceptance.image_hashes: exact before every replayed action and at root; full continue suffix also exact
acceptance.fail_policy: Preserve evidence and stop affected collection; never relax gates or choose a different sample because of a mismatch.

preflight_protocol: Each GPU independently replays and regenerates both a known successful and unsuccessful continue suffix; all four must pass before collecting intervention outcomes.

analysis.units: 269 paired roots nested in 200 episodes and 10 tasks; early/late cohorts reported separately
metrics: paired successes and losses vs continue
additional policy calls and inference seconds
analysis.intervals: Exploratory task-cluster bootstrap; no multiplicity-adjusted or confirmation claim. Roots and branches are not independent episodes.
analysis.oracle: Any-candidate success is only an offline feasibility upper bound, never a deployed selector score.
analysis.feasibility_gate: If at least 8 distinct baseline-failure episodes have a successful alternative and every continue control passes, proceed to frozen-encoder progress/value module development with fixed fit/calibration split. Otherwise improve the recovery candidates/teacher before training a selector; no outcome-driven repeated branch sampling.
analysis.noise_limit: One fixed stochastic stream per method/root; labels are sampled outcomes, not exact conditional expected values.

self_review: Full-episode prefix1 wins do not imply locally recoverable failures; this experiment tests that gap.
Fixed upward/open retreat can drop a held object or collide; it is a bounded simulator candidate, not a safe real-robot controller.
A failure classifier cannot help when no recovery candidate works. The oracle feasibility gate precedes module training.
Preserve successful-case controls to measure false intervention harm; never collect only failed trajectories.
The 60/120 roots are convenient development probes, not a learned trigger or proof of optimal timing.
All geometric/contact labels stay evaluator-side; no object IDs, task IDs or future labels enter policy inputs.
next_stage_requires: Complete integrity and feasibility review, then freeze module architecture, training targets, seeds, costs and held-out calibration rules before training.
